pkgmetadata.longdescription: Lichii is a very experimental Nintendo Switch 2 emulator based on Eden, a yuzu descendant. This package repackages the upstream Linux AppDir tarball, which bundles Qt6, FFmpeg and most other libraries, into /opt/lichii.

use.flag: Install the upstream build optimized with Profile Guided Optimization (profile trained on Ocarina of Time) instead of the regular build
